questions.question: When four kings carried off the goods and people of Sodom, which relative of Abram did they capture?
When Abram heard that his relative Lot had been captured, what did he do with his 318 trained men?

answers.text: Set out after the kings who took Lot
Kept them guarding his tents at Mamre
Sent them with a ransom for Lot

questions.question: After Abram won the battle, Melchizedek, king of Salem, brought something out for him. What was it?
After rescuing Lot, why did Abram refuse to take even a thread from the king of Sodom?

answers.text: So the king could not say he made Abram rich
So the people of Sodom would trust him
So the four kings would not come back for it
